events.text: I've had a cough and fever
Come back in one week if the fever

rows.speaker: doctor
rows.heard: Good morning, Mrs. Chen. Tell me what has been going on.
rows.said: 早上好，陈太太。告诉我发生了什么事。

rows.speaker: patient
rows.heard: 我咳嗽发烧已经五天了。
rows.said: I've had a cough and fever for five days.

rows.speaker: doctor
rows.heard: How many days have you had this cough and fever?
rows.said: 怎么样，你已经咳嗽和发烧几天了？

rows.speaker: patient
rows.heard: 昨天量体温有38度。
rows.said: Yesterday I took my temperature and it was 38 degrees.

rows.speaker: doctor
rows.heard: Tell me one tablet twice a day for five days.
rows.said: 告诉我一天吃两片，吃五天。

rows.speaker: patient
rows.heard: 这个药一天要吃几次?
rows.said: This medicine needs to be taken how many times a day?

rows.speaker: doctor
rows.heard: Do not skip any doses. Even if you start feeling better.
rows.said: 不要漏服任何剂量。即使你感觉好转了。

rows.speaker: patient
rows.heard: 我怕这药吃了会犯困。
rows.said: I'm afraid this medicine will make me drowsy.

rows.speaker: doctor
rows.heard: Come back in one week if the fever continues.
rows.said: 如果一周后发烧还在持续，

rows.speaker: patient
rows.heard: 谢谢医生,麻烦你了。
rows.said: Thank you, doctor, I appreciate it.
